turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is a courtesy call from HDFC Bank. We're informing you about a recent transaction on your credit card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A transaction of 12,500 rupees was made at Amazon yesterday. If this wasn't you, please call the number on the back of your card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Remember, we will never ask for your OTP, PIN, or password. Never share these with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for banking with HDFC. Have a nice day.
